model_output.rationale: All 5 lines denied CO-4/N822 — required therapy discipline modifier absent. Claim carries only KX; no GP/GO/GN on any line. Chart note confirms PT services on 2026-06-05. Per reference 08-therapy-modifiers.md, CO-4+N822 on therapy CPTs (97530, 97140, 97116) = returned unprocessable, no appeal rights. Remedy: add GP to every line, new original claim (CLM05-3=1). Medicare 1-year deadline: 2027-06-05.

root_cause.explanation: All 5 lines carry KX only; GP (physical therapy discipline) is absent on 97530, 97140, and 97116. Chart note confirms PT services. CMS requires a therapy discipline modifier on every outpatient PT CPT.

next_action.detail: Add GP to all 5 lines alongside KX. Submit as new original claim CLM05-3=1 — no REF*F8. Do not appeal; CO-4/N822 = unprocessable, no appeal rights. Deadline 2027-06-05.

evidence.fact: All 5 lines: CO-4 (procedure code inconsistent with modifier or required modifier missing) + N822 (missing procedure modifier(s)), $0 paid.
Modifier on all lines = KX only; no GP, GO, or GN present on any service line.
Explicitly titled 'PT treatment note'; services are therapeutic activities, manual therapy, and gait training — physical therapy services requiring GP.
CO-4+N822 on therapy CPTs = returned unprocessable, no appeal rights; remedy is new original claim (CLM05-3=1) with discipline modifier appended.

citations.rule: CO-4+N822 on always-therapy CPTs = missing discipline modifier; correct_and_resubmit as new original CLM05-3=1; never appeal.
CO = provider liable, never bill patient; provider-side data/coding defect → correct_and_resubmit.
